description: Rounds a signal onto a ladder of equal voltage steps, coarsening it the way a low-resolution converter does

params.text: Sets the height of one step, from 0 to 1V; at 0 the signal passes through untouched
Scales what the CV input adds to the step height, reaching 0.2V of step height per volt at its maximum

inputs.text: Adds to the step height, scaled by its attenuator, with the total clamped between 0 and 1V

outputs.text: The signal rounded down to a step and offset by half a step, so the ladder is centred on the original

notes: the signal is processed at twice the sample rate and filtered back down, which keeps the steps from folding back as aliasing.
the step-height knob draws a gold arc from its own position round to where the CV input has moved it, and the arc turns orange when the CV pushes the step height past 0 or 1V.

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
